overview: Many people open an app once and never return. We review the path from first launch to first success, then improve the onboarding screens, the upgrade or paywall screen and the key buttons and prompts. We add simple event tracking so you can see where people stop. We make no promises about numbers, but each change is built to remove a specific point of friction.

faq: No. Results depend on your product, audience and traffic. We remove clear friction and set up tracking so you can measure each change, but we do not promise a specific increase.
Do you follow Apple's rules for paywalls and prompts?
Yes. We follow the App Review Guidelines on subscriptions, price display, restore purchases and permission requests. We do not use tricks Apple forbids, such as hidden prices or fake countdowns.
Do I need analytics already installed?
No. If you have none, we add a simple event tracker such as Firebase Analytics, or the tool you choose. It must match your privacy policy and Apple's privacy labels, which we help you check.
Can you do this if my app is not live yet?
Yes, for the screens and flows. Some insights, such as where users drop off, need real traffic, so we set up the tracking and a plan to read it after launch.
